finalText:
**`Redis` died and took prod with it.**

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `Redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` gave `ECONNREFUSED` |
| 02:14:07 | cache degraded, reads went straight to the store |
| 02:14:10 | first `TimeoutError` after 5000ms |
| 02:29:12 | queue depth 502, past the 500 max |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory |
| 02:31:52 | supervisor killed api, service down |

All 13 reconnect tries failed at [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). The host never came back. Logs look clean before 02:14.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` went down.
